frame: Provisional frame: x forward, y to port, z up, metres. Origin x=0 at the stem (forward end of LOA, which is also the forestay deck point since SFJ=0), so points aft of the stem have negative x. y=0 on the centreline. z=0 on the ORC measurement-trim flotation plane (no crew, no sails), the plane the certificate freeboards are measured from. hull_hydro.json transform maps it to the body frame (origin at DWL midship): p_body = p + (stem_x_in_body, 0, flotation_z_in_body). Positions assume a vertical (unraked) mast, as ORC measures P, IG and J; see mast_rake for the rake shown on the J/Boats drawing.

rig_type.value: fractional sloop, keel-stepped aluminium mast, two pairs of swept spreaders, roller-furling jib, adjustable split backstay
rig_type.source: J/Boats J/80 Tech Specs page; J/80 Standard Building Specifications (1-Dec-20), items 44-46, 59-69

i_jib.note: IG: height of forestay/mast-front intersection above sheer at mast. J/Boats lists I = 31.50 ft (9.60 m).

j.note: Stem (forestay deck point) to front of mast at sheer. J/Boats lists 9.50 ft (2.90 m).

p.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.2; J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), C.8.1 mast band distance 9144 mm

e.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.2; J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), C.8.2 boom band distance 3810 mm

boom_height_above_sheer.note: BAS, top of boom at the boom band above sheer at mast.

freeboard_at_mast.note: Sheer at mast above the measurement-trim waterplane.

mast_axis_at_sheer.method: mast front minus half of MDL1.

hounds_forestay_on_mast.method: x = -J, z = freeboard at mast + IG.

forestay_deck_point.method: SFJ = 0 puts the forestay at the stem. z extrapolated linearly along the sheer from FFM (0.877 m at SFFP 0.177 m) to the freeboard at mast (0.744 m at J). The ORC p.3 drawing, scaled, gives 0.888 m.

forestay_length.method: distance from forestay_deck_point to hounds_forestay_on_mast; excludes toggles and furler.

mast_top_above_sheer.source: J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png); ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.3
mast_top_above_sheer.method: scaled from both drawings: J/Boats 10.61 m, ORC p.3 10.59 m; mean used. P top band is at 10.444 m.

mast_top_above_water.source: J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png); ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.2
mast_top_above_water.method: mast_top_above_sheer + freeboard at mast, measurement trim.

mast_top_above_deck.method: mast_top_above_sheer minus the cabin-top height at the mast partners (0.29 m above sheer), both scaled from the J/Boats drawing.

mast_rake.method: slope of the mast aft face between 300 and 1000 px on the J/Boats profile drawing, relative to its waterline. Rake is a tuning setting, not a class dimension.

spreader_count.source: J/80 Standard Building Specifications (1-Dec-20), item 45; J/Boats J/80 Tech Specs page
spreader_count.note: two pairs of swept aluminium spreaders. No public source gives spreader length or sweep angle.

spreader_lower_height_above_sheer.method: scaled from the J/Boats rig profile using P = 9.144 m between the bands. Spreader symbols on the ORC p.3 drawing scale to 4.35 m; the ORC drawing is schematic, so the designer's drawing is used.

spreader_upper_height_above_sheer.method: as spreader_lower_height_above_sheer; ORC p.3 symbol scales to 7.39 m.

shroud_chainplate_base.source: J/Boats J/80 rig profile drawing (J80-Rig-700.png); ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1-2
shroud_chainplate_base.method: x: cap shroud meets the deck about 0.14 m aft of the mast aft face on the J/Boats profile. y: assumed just inboard of the 1.24 m half-beam at sheer. Mirror y for starboard.

standing_rigging_wire.value: 1x19 stainless: uppers, lowers and forestay 4.7 mm; intermediates and upper backstay 4.0 mm; lower backstay legs 3.0 mm

jib_furler.value: Harken MkIV Unit 0 or Profurl R250-10J80

mast_weight.source: ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.2; J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), C.8.1 (minimum)

boom_weight_min.note: Class minimum. 2006 rules gave 10.9 kg; the current 2024 value is used.
